**STEP 1 - Scene:** A breakfast plate with scrambled eggs, cooked oatmeal, strawberries, and raspberries. A QR-code placemat sits underneath, and no other plate's food is part of this meal.

**STEP 2 - Vessel:** A white square plate, roughly 20 cm across. Area ≈ 400 cm².

**STEP 3 - Items:** Scrambled eggs, oatmeal (porridge), strawberries (halves and slices), raspberries (about 6). No visible oil, sauce, or dressing.

**STEP 4 - Area:** Eggs ~10%, oatmeal ~10%, strawberries ~14%, raspberries ~5%. Food covers about 39% of the plate, which is consistent with a light breakfast.

**STEP 5 - Volume:** Eggs 40 cm² × 1.5 cm ≈ 60 ml. Oatmeal 40 cm² × 1.5 cm ≈ 60 ml. Strawberries 55 cm² × 1.5 cm ≈ 82 ml. Raspberries 20 cm² × 1.5 cm ≈ 30 ml.

**STEP 6 - Grams:** Eggs 60 ml × 0.9 ≈ 54 g. Oatmeal 60 ml × 0.9 ≈ 54 g. Strawberries 82 ml × 0.6 ≈ 50 g. Raspberries 30 ml × 0.6 ≈ 18 g. Total ≈ 176 g.

**STEP 7 - Energy:** Eggs 54 g × 150 kcal/100 g ≈ 81 kcal. Oatmeal 54 g × 70 kcal/100 g ≈ 38 kcal. Strawberries 50 g × 32 kcal/100 g ≈ 16 kcal. Raspberries 18 g × 52 kcal/100 g ≈ 9 kcal. Total ≈ 144 kcal.

**STEP 8 - Sanity check:** About 176 g and 144 kcal fits a modest breakfast plate that is only partly covered. The oatmeal's calorie density depends on whether it was cooked with milk or water, so the figure could run somewhat higher.
